content.comment_body: I have another question: Currently, my value increases by 5 each time I press, and if I hold the button longer it speeds up. Is there a way to make the value increase much faster, for example by 50, if I hold the button longer than 1 second? And if I press only briefly, it should just increase by 5.

The shortest interval for the asynchronous pulse generator is 10 ms, which is the fastest possible. Note that timing may not be accurate during simulation. If you want to adjust the speed, you can modify the value in the pulse generator using an Analog-MUX. I’ll add this to your program and post it shortly. Please wait a moment...

analysis.insight_summary: Users face limitations with the standard increment rate of the pulse generator and seek more flexible control based on how long a button is pressed. Advice provided includes details on minimum timing constraints and suggests customization through additional logic, such as using an Analog-MUX. Flexibility is possible but currently requires extra configuration steps rather than built-in options.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to easily set increment steps for the pulse generator depending on button press duration, ideally through straightforward adjustments rather than complex programming.
